## Tech Stack

- **React + TypeScript + Vite** SPA, **MUI** UI, **React Query** for server state.
- **State management:** _(set at setup — Redux Toolkit or Zustand)_
- **API transport:** _(set at setup — typed HTTP client, or generated SDK via `--sdk`)_
- **i18n:** typed text registry (`src/i18n/`) — no hardcoded UI strings.

## Getting Started

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm dev        # start the dev server
pnpm build      # typecheck + production build
pnpm lint       # eslint
pnpm test       # vitest
# pnpm generate-sdk   # only when the SDK option is enabled
```

## Project Structure

Feature-slice layout under `src/` (see `project-setup/folder-structure.md`). Routing,

is safe to delete once your first feature exists.
